name: Beef chilli
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan and brown the mince over a high heat, breaking it up as it colours.
Add the onion, garlic, red pepper and chilli. Cook until soft, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the tomato puree and cook out for a minute, then add the chopped tomatoes.
Simmer uncovered for 25 minutes, then stir in the drained kidney beans and heat through.
Cook the rice separately and serve alongside.
